description: When an agent sets a vein to Proven while the person's own Proven request is in flight, the person gets a red STALE notice ("This field changed since it was read… Your draft is preserved…") although the field already holds exactly the value they chose. Their action is rejected (409) and does not appear in Activity.
expected: A concurrent write of the same value is treated as success (or the notice says "Ada already marked this Proven").
actual: An error notice and a 409; the select shows Proven.
suggested_fix: On STALE_UPDATE where the current value equals the requested value, clear the error and show a neutral note.

description: `task create --assignee "Dev Raman"` (and `dev`, `dev-raman`) fail with UNKNOWN_ACTOR. Human handles are opaque ("human-5907ef66-a6b5-46d9-b7c0-25108dd0d5e3"), so an agent must list Actors and paste a 64-hex ID to assign work.
expected: --assignee accepts a display name or a readable handle.
suggested_fix: Resolve unique display names in resolveActor, and give people readable handles at join time.

description: Dismissing the STALE notice on a vein row removes the Dismiss button and focus falls to <body>.
expected: Focus returns to the vein's status select.
suggested_fix: On dismiss, focus the related select.
